## shirakaba/orm

- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\BelongsTo` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/BelongsTo.php`): This entity references one $entity through $foreignKey (a property of this entity).
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\Column` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/Column.php`): Overrides the column name (default: the snake_case parameter name) or converts the value with a ColumnType.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\Computed` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/Computed.php`): Marks a projection parameter whose value the application computes instead of reading it from the entity, such as counts from a separate query.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\CreatedAt` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/CreatedAt.php`): Set from the clock when the entity is inserted.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\DefaultScope` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/DefaultScope.php`): A scope applied to every query of the entity unless the query calls withoutScope().
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\Embedded` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/Embedded.php`): Stores a value object across several columns, named with a prefix ("address_" by default for $address).
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\From` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/From.php`): Fills a projection parameter from an entity property, relation or count of another name : `#[From('notifier')] UserView $user` receives the relation requested with with('notifier'), and `#[From('commentsCount')] int $comments` the withCount('comments') count.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\Generated` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/Generated.php`): The database generates the value (auto-increment, identity or a column default).
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\HasMany` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/HasMany.php`): Many $entity reference this entity through $foreignKey (a property of $entity).
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\HasOne` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/HasOne.php`): One $entity references this entity through $foreignKey (a property of $entity).
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\Id` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/Id.php`): Marks a constructor parameter as (part of) the primary key.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\Items` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/Items.php`): Declares the item class of a list property in a projection, when the items are projections themselves: `#[Items(CommentView::class)] public array $comments`.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\Json` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/Json.php`): Stores an array, or a DTO mapped like a #[JsonBody] (shirakaba/json), as JSON text.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\ManyToMany` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/ManyToMany.php`): Links this entity to many $entity through a join table with two key columns.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\RequiredScope` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/RequiredScope.php`): A scope every query of the entity must receive with scoped(), or switch off by name with withoutScope().
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\SoftDelete` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/SoftDelete.php`): Entities::delete() sets $property (a nullable DateTimeImmutable) instead of deleting the row, and queries skip such rows through the NotDeleted scope.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\Table` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/Table.php`): Marks a class as an entity stored in a table (design/08-database.md).
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\UpdatedAt` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/UpdatedAt.php`): Set from the clock when the entity is inserted or updated.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Attribute\Version` (class, `orm/src/Attribute/Version.php`): An integer incremented by every update(); an update of a stale entity fails with StaleEntity (optimistic locking).
- `Shirakaba\Orm\ColumnType` (interface, `orm/src/ColumnType.php`): Converts a property to and from its column, for types the ORM does not know: `#[Column(type: MoneyType::class)] public Money $price`.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Entities` (class, `orm/src/Entities.php`): Reads and explicit writes of entities (design/08-database.md).
- `Shirakaba\Orm\EntityNotFound` (class, `orm/src/EntityNotFound.php`): Entities::get() found no row.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\EntityQuery` (class, `orm/src/EntityQuery.php`): An immutable query for one entity class, named by properties rather than columns (design/08-database.md).
- `Shirakaba\Orm\MappingError` (class, `orm/src/MappingError.php`): An entity, relation or projection is declared wrongly; a programming error, raised when the mapping is planned.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\NotDeleted` (class, `orm/src/NotDeleted.php`): The default scope of #[SoftDelete] entities: rows whose deletion time is NULL.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\PropertyConditions` (class, `orm/src/PropertyConditions.php`): A group of conditions on entity properties, combined with AND and OR, for EntityQuery::whereGroup().
- `Shirakaba\Orm\SchemaCheck` (class, `orm/src/SchemaCheck.php`): Compares entity mappings with the live schema, for a CI step after migrations:
- `Shirakaba\Orm\SchemaDiff` (class, `orm/src/SchemaDiff.php`): Writes a migration for the difference between entity mappings and the live schema : missing tables (with their foreign keys and many-to-many join tables) and missing columns.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\Scope` (interface, `orm/src/Scope.php`): A filter that applies to every query of an entity, such as "not deleted" or "belongs to tenant 5".
- `Shirakaba\Orm\ScopeMissing` (class, `orm/src/ScopeMissing.php`): A query of an entity with a #[RequiredScope] neither passed the scope nor switched it off; a programming error, raised before anything is read.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\ScopeOnInsert` (interface, `orm/src/ScopeOnInsert.php`): A Scope that can also tell whether a new entity belongs inside it, so that Entities::insert() refuses an entity whose tenant was forged:
- `Shirakaba\Orm\ScopeViolation` (class, `orm/src/ScopeViolation.php`): An entity to insert lies outside a scope it was inserted with, such as a card carrying another organization's id.
- `Shirakaba\Orm\StaleEntity` (class, `orm/src/StaleEntity.php`): An update or delete of a #[Version]ed entity found the row changed (or gone) since it was read.

## shirakaba/phpstan

- `Shirakaba\PHPStan\EntityQueryRule` (class, `phpstan/src/EntityQueryRule.php`): Checks ORM queries against entity mappings: property and relation names in EntityQuery calls and Entities::patch(), the types of compared and patched values, and projections against the relations requested in the same call chain (or, for Entities::into(), against the entity alone).
- `Shirakaba\PHPStan\NoAmbientClockRule` (class, `phpstan/src/NoAmbientClockRule.php`): Reports reads of the wall clock outside a PSR-20 clock: time(), microtime(), date() and friends without a timestamp, and DateTime objects for "now".
- `Shirakaba\PHPStan\NoSharedMutableStateRule` (class, `phpstan/src/NoSharedMutableStateRule.php`): Forbids state that outlives a request in a long-running process (design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md): static properties, `global` and function-level `static` variables.
- `Shirakaba\PHPStan\NoStateInAppScopedObjectRule` (class, `phpstan/src/NoStateInAppScopedObjectRule.php`): Objects that live for the whole application (middleware, handlers, extractors and resolvers) must not write to their own properties after construction: under a worker runtime the next request, or a concurrent one, would see the value (design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md).
- `Shirakaba\PHPStan\PackageSource` (class, `phpstan/src/PackageSource.php`): Which files the long-running safety rules check, configured with `parameters.shirakaba.longRunningPaths` (regular expressions; empty for every file).
- `Shirakaba\PHPStan\QueryInLoopRule` (class, `phpstan/src/QueryInLoopRule.php`): Reports database calls inside loops, the shape of an N+1 query: a call on a Reader or Writer, or any call that receives one, in the body of a loop.
- `Shirakaba\PHPStan\RequiredScopeRule` (class, `phpstan/src/RequiredScopeRule.php`): Reports ORM calls on an entity with a #[RequiredScope] that cannot have the scope, so a forgotten tenant fails in analysis instead of on the code path that runs:
- `Shirakaba\PHPStan\SafeMethodHandlerRule` (class, `phpstan/src/SafeMethodHandlerRule.php`): Handlers registered for safe methods (GET, HEAD) must not take a database Writer, nor a class whose constructor takes one (design/13-static-analysis-and-agents.md and design/08-database.md).
- `Shirakaba\PHPStan\SelectResultTypeExtension` (class, `phpstan/src/SelectResultTypeExtension.php`): Types the rows of `Select::fetchAll()` and `fetchOne()` as array shapes when the query is built in one chain from `Select::from()` with literal column names:

## shirakaba/pubsub

- `Shirakaba\PubSub\ChannelEvent` (class, `pubsub/src/ChannelEvent.php`): One event of an EventChannel (design/11-real-time-events.md): its `type` in the payload and the #[JsonDto] class of the rest of the payload, which does not declare `type` itself.
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\EventChannel` (class, `pubsub/src/EventChannel.php`): Declares a class as a channel of typed hub events (design/11-real-time-events.md):
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\EventChannels` (class, `pubsub/src/EventChannels.php`): Reads #[EventChannel] classes (design/11-real-time-events.md): their topics, their payloads and their description for the OpenAPI generator:
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\InMemoryPubSub` (class, `pubsub/src/InMemoryPubSub.php`): Publish/subscribe within one process, for tests and single-process tools.
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\MercureEvents` (class, `pubsub/src/MercureEvents.php`): Publishes typed events on #[EventChannel]s through a Mercure hub (design/11-real-time-events.md):
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\MercurePublisher` (class, `pubsub/src/MercurePublisher.php`): Publishes to a Mercure 1.0 hub (design/11-real-time-events.md), such as the one built into FrankenPHP, so browsers subscribe to the hub instead of holding a PHP worker and a database connection per stream:
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\MercureTokens` (class, `pubsub/src/MercureTokens.php`): Issues Mercure 1.0 access tokens (design/11-real-time-events.md): JWT access tokens (RFC 9068, header `typ: at+jwt`) signed with HS256, carrying `iss`, `aud`, `sub`, `client_id`, `iat`, `exp`, `jti` and an `authorization_details` entry of type `https://mercure.rocks/authorization-detail` that grants `publish` or `subscribe` on topics.
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\Message` (class, `pubsub/src/Message.php`): One published message as a subscriber receives it.
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\PostgresPubSub` (class, `pubsub/src/PostgresPubSub.php`): Publish/subscribe on PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY (design/11-real-time-events.md).
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\Publisher` (interface, `pubsub/src/Publisher.php`): Publishes messages that subscribers receive once the writer's transaction commits (design/11-real-time-events.md).
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\Subscriber` (interface, `pubsub/src/Subscriber.php`): Subscribes to channels for the life of a request scope (design/11-real-time-events.md).
- `Shirakaba\PubSub\Subscription` (class, `pubsub/src/Subscription.php`): Messages on the subscribed channels, from the moment of subscribing until close() or the end of the request scope.

## shirakaba/query

- `Shirakaba\Query\Compiled` (class, `query/src/Compiled.php`): SQL text and its positional parameters, as sent to the database.
- `Shirakaba\Query\Conditions` (class, `query/src/Conditions.php`): Conditions joined by AND and OR, for WHERE and HAVING.
- `Shirakaba\Query\Delete` (class, `query/src/Delete.php`): An immutable DELETE, run with a Writer.
- `Shirakaba\Query\Filtered` (trait, `query/src/Filtered.php`): WHERE methods shared by Select, Update and Delete; see Conditions.
- `Shirakaba\Query\Insert` (class, `query/src/Insert.php`): An immutable INSERT, run with a Writer:
- `Shirakaba\Query\RowMapper` (class, `query/src/RowMapper.php`): Maps result rows into objects through their constructor.
- `Shirakaba\Query\Select` (class, `query/src/Select.php`): An immutable SELECT.
- `Shirakaba\Query\Sql` (class, `query/src/Sql.php`): A raw SQL fragment with its own parameters, the only way SQL text enters a query .
- `Shirakaba\Query\Update` (class, `query/src/Update.php`): An immutable UPDATE, run with a Writer.
- `Shirakaba\Query\Values` (class, `query/src/Values.php`): Converts a non-null column value, as the driver returned it, to a PHP type (design/07-date-and-time.md): numeric strings to numbers, 0/1 and t/f to booleans, date-times through the dialect in UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD" to LocalDate, backing values to enum cases.

## shirakaba/query-cache

- `Shirakaba\QueryCache\CacheLookup` (class, `query-cache/src/CacheLookup.php`): Reported to observers for every cached read: "db.cache.hit" or "db.cache.miss".
- `Shirakaba\QueryCache\QueryCache` (class, `query-cache/src/QueryCache.php`): Opt-in caching of query results.
- `Shirakaba\QueryCache\Testing\ArrayCache` (class, `query-cache/src/Testing/ArrayCache.php`): A PSR-16 cache in process memory, for tests.

## shirakaba/queue

- `Shirakaba\Queue\CreateJobsTable` (class, `queue/src/CreateJobsTable.php`): The table of the database queue; add it to the application's migrations:
- `Shirakaba\Queue\CreateScheduleTable` (class, `queue/src/CreateScheduleTable.php`): The table that records which scheduled task ran for which minute, so a task runs once per slot however many servers call schedule:run (design/10-background-work.md):
- `Shirakaba\Queue\CronExpression` (class, `queue/src/CronExpression.php`): A five-field cron expression (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week) evaluated in a time zone (design/10-background-work.md).
- `Shirakaba\Queue\DatabaseQueue` (class, `queue/src/DatabaseQueue.php`): Jobs in a database table (design/10-background-work.md), on MySQL 8, PostgreSQL and SQLite.
- `Shirakaba\Queue\JobFailed` (class, `queue/src/JobFailed.php`): Thrown by a job handler when the job cannot succeed however often it runs, such as a mail the server refused for good: the job is failed at once instead of being retried.
- `Shirakaba\Queue\JobOutcome` (enum, `queue/src/JobOutcome.php`)
- `Shirakaba\Queue\JobRunner` (class, `queue/src/JobRunner.php`): Runs jobs: reserves one, decodes it, calls its handler, and acknowledges, retries or fails it (design/10-background-work.md).
- `Shirakaba\Queue\Jobs` (class, `queue/src/Jobs.php`): Maps job classes to stable type names and handlers, and pushes jobs (design/10-background-work.md):
- `Shirakaba\Queue\PushOptions` (class, `queue/src/PushOptions.php`): How a job is queued.
- `Shirakaba\Queue\Queue` (interface, `queue/src/Queue.php`): Where jobs wait (design/10-background-work.md).
- `Shirakaba\Queue\QueueCommands` (class, `queue/src/QueueCommands.php`): Registers the queue commands in a console (design/10-background-work.md):
- `Shirakaba\Queue\ReservedJob` (class, `queue/src/ReservedJob.php`): A job a worker holds until it acknowledges, releases or fails it, or its lease expires.
- `Shirakaba\Queue\RetryPolicy` (class, `queue/src/RetryPolicy.php`): How long a failed job waits before its next attempt: exponential backoff with jitter, so jobs that failed together do not retry together.
- `Shirakaba\Queue\Schedule` (class, `queue/src/Schedule.php`): Recurring work as jobs (design/10-background-work.md).
- `Shirakaba\Queue\ScheduleCommands` (class, `queue/src/ScheduleCommands.php`): Registers the schedule commands in a console (design/10-background-work.md):
- `Shirakaba\Queue\Testing\InMemoryQueue` (class, `queue/src/Testing/InMemoryQueue.php`): A queue in process memory for tests.
- `Shirakaba\Queue\WaitsForJobs` (interface, `queue/src/WaitsForJobs.php`): A queue that can tell an idle worker when a job arrives, instead of the worker polling .
- `Shirakaba\Queue\Worker` (class, `queue/src/Worker.php`): The loop of `queue:work`: runs jobs one at a time and stops between jobs when cancelled (SIGTERM, SIGINT), after a number of jobs, above a memory limit, or when the queue is empty if asked.

## shirakaba/queue-redis

- `Shirakaba\QueueRedis\RedisQueue` (class, `queue-redis/src/RedisQueue.php`): Jobs in Redis (design/10-background-work.md), for applications that keep the queue's traffic away from the database.

## shirakaba/rate-limit

- `Shirakaba\RateLimit\CreateRateLimitsTable` (class, `rate-limit/src/CreateRateLimitsTable.php`): The table of DatabaseRateLimitStore; add it to the application's migrations:
- `Shirakaba\RateLimit\DatabaseRateLimitStore` (class, `rate-limit/src/DatabaseRateLimitStore.php`): Counts hits in a table shared by every process (design/09-security.md): one upsert per hit on the request's connection, outside any transaction, so a failed request still counts.
- `Shirakaba\RateLimit\InMemoryRateLimitStore` (class, `rate-limit/src/InMemoryRateLimitStore.php`): Counts hits in memory, for tests and single-process tools.
- `Shirakaba\RateLimit\RateKey` (class, `rate-limit/src/RateKey.php`): What a route limit counts by (design/09-security.md).
- `Shirakaba\RateLimit\RateLimitMiddleware` (class, `rate-limit/src/RateLimitMiddleware.php`): A route's rate limit, made with RateLimiter::limit().
- `Shirakaba\RateLimit\RateLimitResult` (class, `rate-limit/src/RateLimitResult.php`): The outcome of one hit against a limit.
- `Shirakaba\RateLimit\RateLimitStore` (interface, `rate-limit/src/RateLimitStore.php`): Counts hits per bucket and window (design/09-security.md).
- `Shirakaba\RateLimit\RateLimiter` (class, `rate-limit/src/RateLimiter.php`): Applies rate limits in fixed windows (design/09-security.md): at most $limit hits per $seconds for each name and key.
- `Shirakaba\RateLimit\TooManyRequests` (class, `rate-limit/src/TooManyRequests.php`): A 429 with Retry-After and the RateLimit headers, code `rate-limited`.

## shirakaba/redis

- `Shirakaba\Redis\RedisClient` (class, `redis/src/RedisClient.php`): A Redis client for the commands Shirakaba needs (design/10-background-work.md): RESP2 over a socket, TLS with verified certificates, AUTH, a database number, timeouts and bounded replies.
- `Shirakaba\Redis\RedisError` (class, `redis/src/RedisError.php`): Redis could not be reached, refused a command, or answered something unexpected.

## shirakaba/runtime-frankenphp

- `Shirakaba\Runtime\FrankenPhp\FrankenPhpRuntime` (class, `runtime-frankenphp/src/FrankenPhpRuntime.php`): Runs an application in FrankenPHP worker mode: the application is built once and serves many requests (design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md).

## shirakaba/runtime-roadrunner

- `Shirakaba\Runtime\RoadRunner\RoadRunnerRuntime` (class, `runtime-roadrunner/src/RoadRunnerRuntime.php`): Runs an application as a RoadRunner HTTP worker: the application is built once and serves requests until RoadRunner stops the worker (design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md).

## shirakaba/runtime-swoole

- `Shirakaba\Runtime\Swoole\SwooleRuntime` (class, `runtime-swoole/src/SwooleRuntime.php`): Runs an application on a Swoole HTTP server: each worker process keeps the application and serves many requests, concurrently when coroutine hooks are enabled (design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md).

## shirakaba/sapi

- `Shirakaba\Sapi\SapiEmitter` (class, `sapi/src/SapiEmitter.php`): Sends a PSR-7 response through the SAPI: status line, headers, then the body in chunks, and closes the body afterwards (design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md).
- `Shirakaba\Sapi\ServerRequestBuilder` (class, `sapi/src/ServerRequestBuilder.php`): Builds a PSR-7 server request from the values a classic SAPI provides.

## shirakaba/session

- `Shirakaba\Session\CsrfProtection` (class, `session/src/CsrfProtection.php`): Rejects cross-site requests that change state (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE).
- `Shirakaba\Session\FileSessionStore` (class, `session/src/FileSessionStore.php`): Stores each session as a JSON file.
- `Shirakaba\Session\InMemorySessionStore` (class, `session/src/InMemorySessionStore.php`): Keeps sessions in process memory: for tests, or a single worker process.
- `Shirakaba\Session\JsonData` (class, `session/src/JsonData.php`): Session data as JSON, the format every session store keeps, so a store never PHP-serialises data (a stolen store cannot inject objects).
- `Shirakaba\Session\Session` (class, `session/src/Session.php`): The session of one request, kept in the RequestScope (never in globals, design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md).
- `Shirakaba\Session\SessionMiddleware` (class, `session/src/SessionMiddleware.php`): Loads the session for each request into the RequestScope and saves it afterwards.
- `Shirakaba\Session\SessionStore` (interface, `session/src/SessionStore.php`): Where session data lives between requests.
- `Shirakaba\Session\SetCookie` (class, `session/src/SetCookie.php`): A Set-Cookie header with secure defaults: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/.
- `Shirakaba\Session\Testing\SessionStoreChecks` (class, `session/src/Testing/SessionStoreChecks.php`): What every SessionStore must do, as a list of problems so any test framework can assert on it.

- `Shirakaba\SessionDatabase\DatabaseSessionStore` (class, `session-database/src/DatabaseSessionStore.php`): Keeps sessions in the application's database, so every instance behind a load balancer sees the same session and no instance needs a writable file system:

## shirakaba/streaming

- `Shirakaba\Streaming\GeneratorStream` (class, `streaming/src/GeneratorStream.php`): A read-only, non-seekable body that pulls chunks from an iterable as they are read (design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md).
- `Shirakaba\Streaming\Sse` (class, `streaming/src/Sse.php`): A Server-Sent Events response (text/event-stream).
- `Shirakaba\Streaming\SseEvent` (class, `streaming/src/SseEvent.php`): One Server-Sent Event.
- `Shirakaba\Streaming\SseResponse` (class, `streaming/src/SseResponse.php`): Declares the events of a handler's Sse response (design/11-real-time-events.md), so API descriptions name each event and the type of its data:
- `Shirakaba\Streaming\Streamed` (class, `streaming/src/Streamed.php`): A response whose body is produced chunk by chunk, such as a large export:

## shirakaba/template

- `Shirakaba\Template\Html` (class, `template/src/Html.php`): Markup the application vouches for, printed without escaping in HTML templates and refused in text templates (design/12-mail-and-templates.md).
- `Shirakaba\Template\TemplateChecker` (class, `template/src/TemplateChecker.php`): Finds template mistakes before a mail is sent (design/12-mail-and-templates.md): every template is parsed, and the templates declared with their data class are checked against it: each path must name public properties, printed values must be printable, conditions must test booleans, strings, lists or null, and for blocks must iterate lists (with item types from `list<T>` in PHPDoc).
- `Shirakaba\Template\TemplateCommands` (class, `template/src/TemplateCommands.php`): Registers `templates:check` (design/12-mail-and-templates.md), which parses every template and checks the declared ones against their data classes; it exits with 1 when it finds a problem, for CI:
- `Shirakaba\Template\TemplateDirectory` (class, `template/src/TemplateDirectory.php`): Where templates live (design/12-mail-and-templates.md).
- `Shirakaba\Template\TemplateError` (class, `template/src/TemplateError.php`): A template could not be found, parsed or rendered.
- `Shirakaba\Template\Templates` (class, `template/src/Templates.php`): Renders templates from a directory with data from an object (design/12-mail-and-templates.md):

## shirakaba/time

- `Shirakaba\Time\FrozenClock` (class, `time/src/FrozenClock.php`): A clock for tests: it reports the same instant until moved.
- `Shirakaba\Time\LocalDate` (class, `time/src/LocalDate.php`): A calendar date without a time or timezone, such as a birthday or a due date (design/07-date-and-time.md).
- `Shirakaba\Time\Rfc3339` (class, `time/src/Rfc3339.php`): Strict RFC 3339 date-times (design/07-date-and-time.md): the input must carry an offset, and output is UTC.
- `Shirakaba\Time\SystemClock` (class, `time/src/SystemClock.php`): The wall clock, always in UTC whatever php.ini's date.timezone says.

## shirakaba/trusted-proxy

- `Shirakaba\TrustedProxy\AllowedHosts` (class, `trusted-proxy/src/AllowedHosts.php`): Answers 400 to requests for a host the application does not serve (design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md):
- `Shirakaba\TrustedProxy\CanonicalOrigin` (class, `trusted-proxy/src/CanonicalOrigin.php`): The origin the application is reached at, configured rather than taken from the request, for absolute URLs that must not depend on the Host header: links in e-mails, password-reset and confirmation URLs, OAuth redirect URIs.
- `Shirakaba\TrustedProxy\ClientAddress` (class, `trusted-proxy/src/ClientAddress.php`): The address of the client that sent the request, as determined by TrustedProxies.
- `Shirakaba\TrustedProxy\ForwardedHeader` (enum, `trusted-proxy/src/ForwardedHeader.php`): A forwarding header that the proxies in front of the application set or overwrite.
- `Shirakaba\TrustedProxy\IpRange` (class, `trusted-proxy/src/IpRange.php`): An IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR network.
- `Shirakaba\TrustedProxy\TrustedProxies` (class, `trusted-proxy/src/TrustedProxies.php`): Applies forwarding headers, but only from trusted proxies and only the headers named (design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md):

## shirakaba/validation

- `Shirakaba\Validation\Count` (class, `validation/src/Count.php`): Limits the number of items in a list.
- `Shirakaba\Validation\DateRange` (class, `validation/src/DateRange.php`): Limits a LocalDate or a DateTimeImmutable to fixed, inclusive bounds:
- `Shirakaba\Validation\Email` (class, `validation/src/Email.php`): Requires a syntactically valid e-mail address (PHP's FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL).
- `Shirakaba\Validation\Length` (class, `validation/src/Length.php`): Limits the length of a string in Unicode code points, as JSON Schema counts it.
- `Shirakaba\Validation\NotBlank` (class, `validation/src/NotBlank.php`): Requires a string with at least one non-whitespace character.
- `Shirakaba\Validation\OneOf` (class, `validation/src/OneOf.php`): Restricts a scalar to a fixed set of values.
- `Shirakaba\Validation\Pattern` (class, `validation/src/Pattern.php`): Requires a string to match a regular expression somewhere, like JSON Schema's "pattern"; anchor it with ^ and $ to match the whole string.
- `Shirakaba\Validation\Range` (class, `validation/src/Range.php`): Limits a number to an inclusive range.
